task.title: Configuring the Red Hat Quay auto-pruning feature
task.shortdesc: To enable auto-pruning in Red Hat Quay, you can set FEATURE_AUTO_PRUNE to true in your config.yaml file.

ul.li: You have set FEATURE_UI_V2 to true in your config.yaml file.
